name: Fran Bluebell
source:
Fran is Alice's classmate at the Royal Magic Academy.

Born into the prestigious Bluebell family, Fran quickly rose through the ranks to become a knight of the kingdom at a young age, earning a position as one of the Queen's closest aides. Currently, under a secret order from the Queen, Fran attends the academy as a student.

Coming from a lineage of knights and burdened by an inferiority complex due to her exceptionally talented elder brother, Fran has chosen to disguise herself as a boy, rigorously training in swordsmanship and magic.

Yet beneath her stoic exterior, she secretly dreams of wearing cute outfits and some good old-fashioned girly fun...?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3562120/view/523103429639275159] Steam [/url]]
